title: Ötzi-Dorf Umhausen
highlights: Archaeological open-air park depicting life in the Neolithic Copper Age
Faithfully reconstructed dwellings and workshops from the era of Ötzi
Interactive demonstrations of ancient bushcraft, archery, and toolmaking
Prehistoric animal breeds such as Przewalski horses and Soay sheep
kurzbeschreibung: The Ötzi-Dorf in Umhausen is an archaeological open-air park that brings life in the Stone Age vividly to life.
beschreibung:
Journey Back in Time to the Neolithic Era

The Ötzi-Dorf in Umhausen in the Ötztal provides an impressive insight into everyday life more than 5,000 years ago, when the world-famous Iceman roamed the Ötztal Alps. Across the expansive open-air grounds, Stone Age dwellings, storage huts, and workplaces have been faithfully reconstructed.

Hands-on Archaeology and Ancient Breeds

Visitors can try their hand at making fire, archery, and baking bread according to ancient recipes. Historic livestock breeds such as Soay sheep and Przewalski horses populate the site. A visit to the Ötzi-Dorf pairs perfectly with a trip to the adjacent Greifvogelpark Umhausen.
